isSharable.description:
If true, when the connection was originally borrowed, it was indicated that the connection could be shared with
other actions that required a read only connection that could be shared.

startedTimestamp.description: Time when ref was created.  Used to check for exceeding max lifetime

refCount.description: Current number of holders of the connection.

title: Used by {@link Datastore} for managing shared read connections.
name: ReadOnlyConnRef
